verdict.rationale: Yubico documents all three hardware-backed SSH paths: FIDO2 sk-ssh keys generated on-device with OpenSSH (private key never leaves hardware, touch required per operation), PIV smartcard usage via PKCS#11 for sign/encrypt with SSH, and OpenPGP smartcard keys for SSH auth. Community corroboration confirms FIDO2/PIV/OpenPGP smartcard functionality and touch-to-sign is genuinely enforced (not remotely bypassable). Missing for 10: no independent hands-on benchmark of ed25519 sk-ssh key generation end-to-end, and some community friction noted around PIN/touch UX onboarding.
